findings.evidenceJa: セイバーとの打ち合い
findings.governingReading: the exchange of blows with Saber
findings.explanation: The concrete practice bout becomes the broader training session.

findings.evidenceJa: 剣を手にして戦う技法
findings.governingReading: techniques for fighting with a sword in hand
findings.explanation: A practical combat method is compressed into a formal discipline.

findings.highlight: so that I can stay composed
findings.evidenceJa: 平常心と運動能力を発揮できるよう
findings.governingReading: so he can properly exercise both composure and physical capacity
findings.explanation: Half of Saber’s training objective—retaining bodily performance under lethal pressure—is omitted.

findings.highlight: There’s no way she can teach me swordsmanship in a day or two
findings.evidenceJa: 一日二日で有効な剣術が得られる筈がない
findings.governingReading: there is no possibility of acquiring useful sword skill in one or two days
findings.explanation: The limit is on Shirou’s rapid acquisition; mirror moon reassigns it to Saber’s ability to teach.

findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎が頼りにするのは
findings.governingReading: what Emiya Shirou can rely on
findings.explanation: The deliberate third-person self-appraisal loses its hard, objectifying tone.

findings.highlight: the best training I can get
findings.evidenceJa: 何より確かな剣になる
findings.governingReading: will become his surest sword
findings.explanation: The governing metaphor that combat experience itself is Shirou’s dependable weapon disappears.

findings.highlight: As soon as my focus wavers
findings.evidenceJa: 余分な雑念を抱いた瞬間
findings.governingReading: the instant he entertains extraneous thoughts
findings.explanation: The exact mental lapse becomes a generic concentration failure.

findings.evidenceJa: 竹刀が胸を突いた
findings.governingReading: the bamboo sword thrusts into his chest
findings.explanation: The attack type changes from a thrust to an unspecified strike.

findings.evidenceJa: ごほ、と咳き込む
findings.governingReading: coughing with a “goho”
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits the voiced cough and adds that it is weak.

findings.highlight: surprisingly sharp at times, but defenseless at others
findings.evidenceJa: 驚くほど鋭い時もあれば、呆れるほど隙だらけ
findings.governingReading: sometimes astonishingly sharp and at others so full of openings as to be appalling
findings.explanation: The balanced extremes in Saber’s appraisal are weakened, especially the degree of Shirou’s vulnerability.

findings.evidenceJa: きょろり、とセイバーの視線が外に向けられる
findings.governingReading: Saber’s gaze darts outside
findings.explanation: The quick eye movement interrupting her unfinished instruction is flattened.

findings.highlight: Sakura is waving her hand at us
findings.evidenceJa: 桜が手を振っています
findings.governingReading: Sakura is waving from the veranda
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds that Sakura waves specifically at both of them even though Saber infers she is calling Shirou.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜はなんだかんだ言って
findings.governingReading: after all her earlier objections, Sakura could no longer bear
findings.explanation: The narration’s acknowledgment of Sakura’s persistence and prior stance disappears.

findings.highlight: She went back to the living room
findings.evidenceJa: 所在なげに居間に戻っていった
findings.governingReading: she returned to the living room looking ill at ease and unsure what to do
findings.explanation: Her helpless emotional state after Shirou refuses her is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 早足で居間に行くと
findings.governingReading: when he walks briskly to the living room
findings.explanation: The speed of his response to Sakura’s summons disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 電話の前で立ち尽くしていた
findings.governingReading: standing motionless before the telephone
findings.explanation: A frozen, uneasy posture becomes neutral location.

findings.highlight: Sakura gets away from the phone
findings.evidenceJa: 電話の前から離れる桜
findings.governingReading: Sakura steps away from the telephone
findings.explanation: A normal movement is rendered with language suggesting escape.

findings.evidenceJa: 無断で学校休んでんのよ
findings.governingReading: absent from school without telling anyone
findings.explanation: Rin objects that Shirou gave no notice; mirror moon makes her the authority who must grant permission.

findings.highlight: make her voice rattle the walls
findings.evidenceJa: 部屋中に響き渡るほどの音量
findings.governingReading: produce enough volume to reverberate throughout the room
findings.explanation: The magical-volume joke gains unsupported physical wall-rattling.

findings.evidenceJa: きいたぁ
findings.governingReading: that got me or that hurt
findings.explanation: Shirou’s pained reaction becomes a generic interjection.

findings.highlight: I shake my head to clear the ringing
findings.evidenceJa: 耳鳴りがあたまをシェイクする
findings.governingReading: the ringing in his ears shakes his head
findings.explanation: The comic personification reverses the actor and adds an attempt to clear the ringing.

findings.evidenceJa: そりゃご苦労さまだったな
findings.governingReading: well, thanks for going to all that trouble
findings.explanation: Shirou’s sarcastic acknowledgment of Rin’s worry disappears.

findings.highlight: make you come calling me like that
findings.evidenceJa: いきなり電話してきて
findings.governingReading: calling him out of nowhere
findings.explanation: A telephone call becomes awkward language suggesting an in-person visit.

findings.evidenceJa: ちょっとよくない想像した
findings.governingReading: she had some mildly bad thoughts or imaginings
findings.explanation: mirror moon attaches “slightly” to the imagined event and produces unnatural English.

findings.evidenceJa: 裏山に埋められた
findings.governingReading: buried in the hill behind the temple
findings.explanation: The specific grim hiding place becomes an unidentified mountain.

findings.evidenceJa: ちょっとよくない想像
findings.governingReading: a mildly unpleasant imagining
findings.explanation: The English treats imagination as a countable bad object rather than the content Rin pictured.

findings.evidenceJa: 今にも死にそうだが
findings.governingReading: he looks or feels as though he might die at any moment
findings.explanation: Comic exaggeration of his condition becomes a literal progressive death claim.

findings.evidenceJa: もういなかった
findings.governingReading: the Master was no longer there
findings.explanation: The source reports absence at the scene; “gone” can imply escape or departure.

findings.highlight: I can’t talk any more about this subject
findings.evidenceJa: これ以上つっこんだ発言はできない
findings.governingReading: he cannot make any more deeply probing or explicit remarks
findings.explanation: The constraint concerns how far he can go in what he says, not whether he may continue the topic at all.

findings.evidenceJa: 死んだだの死なないだの
findings.governingReading: talk of someone dying or not dying
findings.explanation: The repeated binary phrasing and its comic danger are generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: わかってるじゃない
findings.governingReading: you do understand after all
findings.explanation: Rin grudgingly acknowledges his correct inference; mirror moon praises consideration instead.

findings.evidenceJa: ガチャン、ツーツー
findings.governingReading: a clack followed by the telephone’s busy tone
findings.explanation: The audible confirmation that Rin has hung up is reduced to an impact sound.

findings.evidenceJa: 茶でも淹れてくるよ
findings.governingReading: the tea he said he would make while he was there
findings.explanation: mirror moon turns an incidental offer into a promise.

findings.evidenceJa: 熱なんてありません
findings.governingReading: she has no fever at all
findings.explanation: Sakura’s explicit answer to Shirou’s health question disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: それに首をかしげながら
findings.governingReading: tilting his head at her reply
findings.explanation: A physical sign of bafflement becomes an abstract interpretation of Sakura’s behavior.

findings.evidenceJa: 外はすっかり茜色に染まっていた
findings.governingReading: everything outside had been completely dyed madder-red
findings.explanation: The scope, completion, and specific color of the evening transition are weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: これからソースの味付け
findings.governingReading: he is about to season or adjust the sauce
findings.explanation: Preparing the sauce’s flavor becomes applying it to the food.

findings.evidenceJa: 終わったら焼きに入る
findings.governingReading: once that is done, he will begin grilling
findings.explanation: The cooking method and ordered transition disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 大鉢出してくれ
findings.governingReading: bring out the large serving bowl
findings.explanation: One specific large vessel becomes unspecified plural bowls.

findings.highlight: Fuji-nee went out and bought some crabs
findings.evidenceJa: 藤ねえが奮発してカニ買ってきてくれた
findings.governingReading: Taiga splurged and bought crab for them
findings.explanation: Her generosity and unusual expense disappear, while crab becomes plural.

findings.evidenceJa: カニ風味かまぼこ五目
findings.governingReading: the mixed-ingredient preparation with crab-flavored fish cake
findings.explanation: The complete dish description is reduced to one imitation-crab ingredient.

findings.evidenceJa: 美味しくてキレイ
findings.governingReading: delicious and beautiful
findings.explanation: Sakura’s aesthetic enthusiasm is weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: 両手で大鉢を取り出し
findings.governingReading: takes out the large bowl with both hands
findings.explanation: Number, size, and Sakura’s two-handed physical action disappear.

findings.highlight: to thank her for everything she did today
findings.evidenceJa: 朝と昼のお礼をかねて
findings.governingReading: in thanks for breakfast and lunch
findings.explanation: Two specific meals in their reciprocal care are generalized to all Sakura did that day.

findings.evidenceJa: この忙しい時に呼び鈴が鳴った
findings.governingReading: the doorbell rings in the middle of this busy moment
findings.explanation: Interruption remains, but the pressure of the active cooking work is omitted.

findings.highlight: I have a bad feeling about this
findings.evidenceJa: 胸騒ぎがする
findings.governingReading: he feels an ominous agitation in his chest
findings.explanation: A bodily premonition becomes a stock prediction.

findings.evidenceJa: 摩り下ろしていた大根
findings.governingReading: the daikon he was grating
findings.explanation: The ingredient and ongoing preparation are reduced to a generic vegetable.

findings.highlight: Whoever it is, they must be hysterical
findings.evidenceJa: ヒステリックなものを思わせるチャイムの連打
findings.governingReading: a barrage of chimes that suggests something hysterical
findings.explanation: An impression created by the ringing becomes a factual diagnosis of the unseen visitor.

findings.evidenceJa: さぁ、そろそろウチに帰る時間だぞ、桜
findings.governingReading: come now, Sakura, it is about time to go home
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces Shinji’s affectedly ordinary command with an angry accusatory question.

findings.highlight: I hear a heavy sound and some angry words.
findings.evidenceJa: 荒々しく踏み込んでくる音とは噛み合わない、取り繕った大仰な声
findings.governingReading: an affected, grandiose voice at odds with the rough sound of someone barging in
findings.explanation: The mature branch deletes the essential mismatch between Shinji’s violence and performed civility.

findings.evidenceJa: 取り繕った大仰な声
findings.governingReading: an affected, grandiose voice
findings.explanation: mirror moon preserves artificiality but changes theatrical grandiosity into smoothness.

findings.evidenceJa: 玄関を開けて身を乗り出してくる慎二
findings.governingReading: Sakura opens the entry and Shinji leans his body in through it
findings.explanation: Door-opening agency moves from Sakura to Shinji, and his looming lean becomes a forceful throw.

findings.evidenceJa: 身を乗り出してくる慎二
findings.governingReading: Shinji leans in through the doorway
findings.explanation: The two branches produce different generic entrances, and the extracted combined witness exposes overlapping endings instead of the source’s exact posture.

findings.evidenceJa: さぁ、そろそろウチに帰る時間だぞ、桜
findings.governingReading: it is time to go home, Sakura
findings.explanation: The mature branch again substitutes an angry question for the intentionally repeated affected command.

findings.highlight: Shinji sees Sakura, he raises his arm
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二は桜の腕をつかみ
findings.governingReading: Shinji immediately grabs Sakura’s arm
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces seizure of Sakura’s arm with Shinji raising his own arm to strike.

findings.highlight: He smacks her, but what slams into her cheek isn’t the palm of his hand, but a fist.
findings.evidenceJa: 狼狽する桜に構わず
findings.governingReading: without regard for Sakura’s confusion, he pulls her toward the exit
findings.explanation: The mature branch inserts a fist blow to Sakura’s cheek absent from the original Japanese scene.

findings.evidenceJa: 玄関口から外に向かおうとする
findings.governingReading: he tries to head outside from the entryway while holding Sakura
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits that Shinji is forcibly taking Sakura with him and the exact doorway staging.

findings.highlight: Sakura hits the wall and crumples to the floor.
findings.evidenceJa: 駆けつけた時には
findings.governingReading: Shirou runs and reaches the entry as Shinji is stepping out
findings.explanation: The mature branch inserts Sakura being knocked into a wall and collapsing.

findings.highlight: Shinji runs to Sakura, with his arm ready to punch her again
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二が玄関から一歩踏み出しかけていた
findings.governingReading: Shinji is already about to take one step out through the entry
findings.explanation: The mature branch inserts a second intended punch and reverses Shinji’s movement away from the house.

findings.highlight: I’ll do whatever I want. If she spends the night at someone’s house without my permission, it’s only natural that she gets punished.
findings.evidenceJa: 妹を連れて帰るために兄貴が迎えに来た
findings.governingReading: an older brother has come to collect his sister and take her home
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces Shinji’s plausible familial pretense with an explicit claim of arbitrary authority and deserved punishment.

findings.evidenceJa: 連れて帰る、だって？
findings.governingReading: take her home, he says?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s disbelief at removal of Sakura becomes a response to the invented punishment claim.

findings.highlight: a piece of shit who won’t do as she’s told deserves to get hit
findings.evidenceJa: 兄貴が来たらおかしいっていうのか
findings.governingReading: is it strange for an older brother to come collect his sister
findings.explanation: The mature branch inserts a vulgar justification for striking Sakura in place of Shinji’s performed normality.

findings.highlight: You’re the one who’s seducing her
findings.evidenceJa: 人の妹を唆してる
findings.governingReading: you are the one coaxing or enticing another man’s sister
findings.explanation: A broad accusation of leading Sakura astray becomes explicitly sexual seduction.

findings.highlight: How are you any different from me? We’re both using Sakura as we please.
findings.evidenceJa: 僕の弱みを握ろうなんて考えているんじゃないだろうね
findings.governingReading: surely Shirou is not planning to gain leverage over Shinji through Sakura
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces the leverage accusation with an invented equivalence in sexually or instrumentally using Sakura.

findings.evidenceJa: 慎二は、平然と
findings.governingReading: Shinji, perfectly composed, continues
findings.explanation: The contrast between the provocation and Shinji’s unruffled delivery disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 言葉がない
findings.governingReading: Shirou is speechless
findings.explanation: The mature branch inserts an incomplete abandoned thought after already stating that Shirou is speechless.

findings.highlight: You got to do her once last night, and now you don’t want to let her go because you want more? I can’t blame you, Sakura is
findings.evidenceJa: 大事な妹を盾にして
findings.governingReading: using his precious sister as a shield
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces the shield accusation with explicit sexual claims and ends on an unfinished objectifying remark.

findings.highlight: hide yourself? That’s a pretty terrible thing
findings.evidenceJa: 陰にコソコソ隠れようってのかい？　そりゃまた随分と卑怯な真似
findings.governingReading: hide furtively in the shadows—a remarkably cowardly act
findings.explanation: Spatial furtiveness and the accusation of cowardice become vague badness.

findings.evidenceJa: そんなコトを、口にした
findings.governingReading: Shinji calmly voices that provocation
findings.explanation: The mature branch inserts an explicit fragment that Shirou wants to kill Shinji.

findings.evidenceJa: そんなコトを、口にした
findings.governingReading: Shinji calmly said such a thing
findings.explanation: The non-mature line drops Shinji as actor and leaves a sentence fragment whose implied subject can be misread as Shirou.

findings.evidenceJa: 冷静になるコトなんて、出来ない
findings.governingReading: he cannot possibly become calm
findings.explanation: Loss of composure becomes loss of behavioral control, anticipating action beyond the script’s unfinished endpoint.
